briefdescription.para: Manages a three-tier (hot / warm / cold) storage hierarchy.

detaileddescription.para: Provides transparent put/get/del operations that route to the correct tier, and runs a background TierMigrationWorker that moves data between tiers according to the configured age- and access-based policies.
Data integrity guarantee: migration uses copy-then-delete so that a crash mid-migration always leaves at least one valid copy.
Thread-Safety: All public methods are thread-safe.
